text:
ITEM 1 | Pale green leafy vegetable, crisp-looking ruffled leaves with lighter pale-yellow-green center ribs, spread across the upper-middle of the plate covering roughly 30% of the plate, with a slightly glossy, dressed sheen and small flecks of pale grated cheese scattered on top; leaves about 5-10 cm long | 120
ITEM 2 | Pale grated or shaved cheese, off-white to cream flakes and shards with slightly crumbly edges, scattered over the leafy greens and near the cauliflower, covering about 5% of the plate | 15
ITEM 3 | Dark green wilted leaves, limp and glossy with a dressing-coated sheen, mixed among the pale greens in the center-lower area, covering about 8% of the plate with pieces about 3-6 cm | 40
ITEM 4 | Cauliflower florets, pale cream-white with slight yellowish tint, firm bumpy clusters about 2-4 cm across, one larger floret at upper right and smaller florets along the lower right edge, covering about 12% of the plate, with a little matte moisture | 110
ITEM 5 | Cooked rice grains, pale off-white with some orange-tinged grains and dark specks, loose and separate, sitting in a mound at lower left covering about 8% of the plate, about 5 cm across | 60
ITEM 6 | Brown cooked meat or vegetable pieces, dark brown with browned edges and a slightly glossy sauce, irregular chunks about 1-3 cm, mixed with the rice at lower left covering about 5% of the plate | 35
ITEM 7 | Orange cooked vegetable pieces, bright orange with soft-looking edges and slight glaze, small cubes about 1-2 cm, near the lower center of the rice mound covering about 2% of the plate | 12
ITEM 8 | Creamy pale sauce or dressing, thin white-cream film with slight sheen coating the greens and cauliflower, spread over about 10% of the plate surface | 15
